Category discovery: ES's home-page SSR mega-menu HTML exposed 232 unique '-nNNNN' category links directly (broader top-level exposure than DE needed); a handful of known DE/UK leaf ids not present at top level (Bedroom Lamps n966, and five Mirrors children n965/n4888/n4889/n4890/n4963, plus Hooks n4857) were resolved via direct nonsense-slug-plus-real-id 200/redirect requests against the ES domain, exactly as DE did against UK/AE ids -- all resolved cleanly to ES's own Spanish canonical slugs. Each leaf qty is the productIds array length from /itxrest/3/catalog/store/84009900/80290093/category/<id>/product?showProducts=false&showNoStock=false&withSubCategories=false&languageId=-5&appId=1 (categoryId read from each page's own embedded SSR breadcrumb/product-deep-link JSON), independently re-read in two full separate passes minutes apart -- all 36 leaf values and all internal categoryIds identical both times, no drift. ES renders no 'N items' header anywhere in the grid, matching UK/DE/UAE; qty is the exact server-rendered productIds count, same method validated on all three sibling country sites. RULE 0: included Bathroom Lighting (bano-lamparas-iluminacion-n5792, qty 5) and Bathroom Mirrors (bano-espejos-n2468, qty 10), which a room-word exclusion would have wrongly dropped, plus Bedroom Lamps (dormitorio-lamparas-n966, qty 41) and Kids Lamps and Lighting (ninos-dormitorio-lamparas-n1117, qty 17), all real decorative-lighting/mirror room branches -- same set DE/UK included.
